steps.instruction: Read the exact request and declared evidence. Bind one immutable release and manifest digest, target, passing quality evidence, required migration proof, existing deploy authorization, probes, steady deadline, rollback identity and open coverage record. Production authorization must already exist.

calls.purpose: Read release, authority and predecessor evidence.
Verify immutable source and manifest provenance.

steps.instruction: Observe artifact availability, host, active digest, schema, domain, target revision and credential custody before effects. Classify each state reusable, missing, invalid, foreign or uncertain and record compare-and-set preconditions.

calls.purpose: Read declared target and public probe state.

steps.instruction: Apply only approved compare-and-set preparation and rollout effects for the same immutable release. Record every attempted effect and its precondition. Never substitute an artifact, expand target scope or repeat an uncertain effect.

calls.purpose: Apply the authorized target rollout by immutable digest.
Persist attempted effects and compare-and-set revisions.

steps.instruction: Observe the active digest and timestamped health and readiness probes after rollout or an uncertain result. Detect a third-party release before any further action. Require fresh observation before retrying any effect.

calls.purpose: Collect bounded health and readiness observations.

steps.instruction: Only after observed rollout failure, apply approved bounded reversible actions one at a time for the same release, observing after each. If exhausted, restore only the authorized rollback identity by exact digest after proving it exists and is data-compatible.

calls.purpose: Apply one approved recovery action or exact-digest rollback.
calls.when: only on the authorized fallback branch

calls.purpose: Observe target state after each fallback action.
Persist each fallback observation and effect.

produces: Ordered recovery or rollback transcript when needed.

steps.instruction: Compare authority, immutable identity, compare-and-set effects, active digest, observation window and fallback branch. Produce concrete defects. A rollback reports the predecessor restored and never claims the new release deployed.

calls.purpose: Persist the deployment or rollback receipt from observed state.

produces: Concrete failed-criterion feedback or passing review results.

steps.instruction: Write and validate the response with actual artifacts, observations and review results. Present healthy deployment only after steady state is proved; otherwise present the actual active state and failure.

calls.purpose: Present the observed active state and probes.
